value.rationale: Three-point exchange is the first possible motion among classical extremal nontrivial seven-point blockers. Connectedness, the exact 3-step diameter and geometric characterization of all disjoint antipodes are non-implied by classical incidence counts. They provide a natural complete finite optimum-solution reconfiguration invariant rather than arbitrary numerical slices or a textbook bound.
